profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal-leaning social values (co-authored); modest pro-transparency
summary: Cotabato 3rd District representative with about 53 principal-authored bills. Authored 13th-month pay for government COS/JO workers, flexible work for pregnant workers and mothers, affordable medicines for persons with disability and a bank-secrecy waiver for officials. Co-authored equal spousal and parental decision-making, technology-facilitated violence, minimum wage and anti-dynasty bills.
caveat: Social and democratic scores rest partly on co-authored bills, which do not prove endorsement of every provision. No votes or statements reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 13th-month pay for government COS/JO workers (-2) and affordable medicines for persons with disability (-2); co-authored minimum wage and low-cost housing loan restructuring (-2, discounted). Three issues, bill-based only.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB02536, HB07711; co-author HB08081, HB00094, HB06276 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Co-authored equal spousal and parental decision-making (+3) and defining technology-facilitated violence against women and children (+2), discounted as co-authorship; authored flexible work arrangements for pregnant workers and mothers. Two issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: co-author HB10775, HB10778, HB08420; authored HB02540 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored waiver of bank secrecy for government officials (+2); co-authored anti-dynasty bills (+2, discounted as a common coalition bill). Two issues, bill-based.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB05447; co-author HB06771, HB08389 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
